Class TurnOrderSlot

java.lang.Object
model.board.TurnOrderSlot
public class TurnOrderSlot extends Object
Represents a slot in the turn order tile where a player's totem can be placed. Each slot has an associated food bonus and may be designated as the last slot, which applies penalties instead of bonuses. When a player's totem returns to a slot, the slot's effect is resolved (food bonus or penalty).

  • Constructor Details

    • TurnOrderSlot

      public TurnOrderSlot(int foodBonus, boolean isLast)
      Constructs a TurnOrderSlot with a specified food bonus and last slot designation.
      Parameters:
      foodBonus - the amount of food granted when this slot's effect is applied (0 or positive)
      isLast - true if this is the last slot with a penalty effect, false otherwise

  • Method Details

    • applyEffect

      public void applyEffect()
      Applies the slot's effect to the occupant player. If this is the last slot, applies a food/prestige penalty to the player. Otherwise, if the slot has a positive food bonus, grants the bonus to the player. Additionally, if the player has the "extra food on totem return" building, grants an extra food point when the bonus is applied.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the slot is not occupied when this method is called
      See Also:
      • Player.removeFoodWithPrestigePenalty(int, int)
      • Player.addFood(int)
      • Player.hasExtraFoodOnTotemReturn()
